tools.name: scan_public_repo
tools.description: Scan a public GitHub repository using ShipReady's live /scan pipeline. Returns a point-in-time score, counts and up to three findings; no private repos or tenant data. A score is not a certification or release approval.

tools.name: ask_compliance
tools.description: Find relevant public ShipReady compliance guides. Returns sourced excerpts, not legal advice or an assertion that ShipReady supports a framework.
